SLBSNSU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SLBSNSU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University (SLBSNSU) for hiring qualified professionals on a contract basis in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) specifically for the Hindu Adhyayan Vibhag department under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position in the Hindu Adhyayan Vibhag department.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in the relevant subject with 55% marks along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. degree to apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a remuneration of 1,500/- per lecture up to a maximum limit of 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application and selection mode is entirely through a Walk-in Interview process where candidates must report directly to the venue.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 08 October 2026. Candidates must attend with all necessary documentation.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, making it free for eligible candidates to participate in the walk-in drive.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and application form by visiting the official university website at www.slbsrsv.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a filled application form, original educational certificates, mark sheets, ID proofs, and self-attested photocopies of all documents.
